title: firerunner usage event, schema 1
description: One job a runner ran, written once after the job completed, when its start is known or after a grace. Read with `firerunner usage`; count each event_id once, as delivery is at least once. An event is never changed: a correction will be an event of its own. Adding a field keeps the schema number; changing or removing one makes a new number.

event_id.description: Stable across redelivery and replay: "job/" and GitHub's job id. Dedupe on it.

tenant.description: The tenants list's id of the tenant; empty for the install the daemon's flags name.

job_id.description: GitHub's job id. A re-run attempt is a job of its own.

event_name.description: What triggered the run: push, pull_request, ...

result.description: As GitHub reported it: succeeded, failed, canceled, ...

tier.description: The tier, which is the runs-on label the job asked for.

instance_type.description: Empty when no launch was recorded, as for a Firecracker tier.

market.description: spot or on-demand; empty as instance_type.

supply.description: How the machine was supplied: cold, pool or kept; empty as instance_type.

started_at.description: UTC. GitHub's start of the job, or else the runner's report of taking it; null when neither was recorded.

completed_at.description: UTC. GitHub's end of the job.

duration_ms.description: completed_at less started_at, in whole milliseconds; 0 when started_at is null. Rounding to a billing unit is billing's.
